title: A headless sprint worker's tokens reach backlog.py cost for its item
goal: A worker that /kb-sprint run starts with claude -p in .claude/worktrees/agent-<id> on work/<id>, with the project settings, has its usage attributed to its item, so backlog.py cost ID and cost --rework SP show it; in SP-hm4qgf3t every item's cost read zero apart from the orchestrator's own prompts and land warned 'landed with no work rows' for ST-ji32ouga and ST-3kw6d6cz, while the workers' own result events counted about 45M tokens.
notes: Evidence SP-7y6dk257 (2026-10-09): the three headless workers (claude -p from .claude/worktrees/agent-<id> on work/<id>) and the headless reviewer left no work rows; land warned 'landed with no work rows' for ST-2p5ywkam and ST-rt27cx3w, and cost --rework SP-7y6dk257 showed only the orchestrator's open session. The workers' own JSON reported 0.59, 0.99 and 1.72 USD list, the reviewer 1.37.
